{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows with invalid age (-1)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age for those who converted
mean_age_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
mean_age_converted"}
